crossglen_valentina_10.m: Do you really need to ask me that? Please leave my house and come back when I have calmed down.

crossglen_valentina_andor_10.m: I should be able to help you, but first you have to tell me where have you been?
r: I've traveled great distances from home and have seen my fair share of Dhayavar during my search for Andor.
I've been around a lot of Dhayavar and have spoken to a lot of people about Andor.
I've talked with a potion maker.
I've been to Remgard looking for Andor
I've been to this really cool place called Blackwater settlement.
I've not gone much past Sullengard.
I've been running around a lot, but I've not learned much.

crossglen_valentina_andor_20.m: I see my child. I can also see that your confidence and skills have grown tremendously, but tell me, with all this adventuring, have you been to Brightport yet?
r: [While holding back a smirk, you lie] Yes, why?

crossglen_valentina_andor_21.m: I see my child. Tell me, with your limited adventuring, have you made it to Brightport yet?
r: [While holding back a smirk, you lie] Yes, why?

crossglen_valentina_andor_25.m: Don't you remember who lives there?

crossglen_valentina_andor_30.m: What? Why not? Don't you remember who lives there?

crossglen_valentina_andor_40.m: Andor's best friend from school, Stanwick. If you remember, they are very close friends. Maybe Stanwick has seen Andor?
r: Stanwick? I never liked that kid. He's really annoying and always picked on me. I really don't want to talk to him.
Are you sure that this is worth it? All the information that I have is pointing me to Nor City.

crossglen_valentina_andor_50.m: Yes, I think you should go to Brightport and seek him out. Maybe, just maybe, he could be helpful to us for once.
r: Thanks, mother. I will go to Brightport next.

crossglen_valentina_andor_55.m: Nor City?! What do you know about Nor City?
r: Well, I know there is a lady named 'Lydalon' there.

crossglen_valentina_andor_60.m:
Oh, OK. Just be careful there.
Anyways...

r: I would like to learn more about Aunt Valeria.

crossglen_valentina_valeria_10.m: Right now? No. I am not ready to discuss this with you.
r: Well, I look forward to a time where you will be ready.

bwm_agent.1: I met a man seeking help for his settlement, the 'Blackwater mountain'. Supposedly, his settlement is being attacked by monsters and bandits, and they need help from the outside.
bwm_agent.5: I have agreed to help the man and Blackwater mountain in dealing with the problem.
bwm_agent.10: The man told me to meet him on the other side of the collapsed mine. He will crawl through the mine shaft and I will descend into the pitch-black abandoned mine.
bwm_agent.20: I have navigated through the pitch-black abandoned mine, and met the man on the other side. He seemed very anxious about telling me to head straight to the east once I exit the mine. I should meet the man at the bottom of the mountain to the east.
bwm_agent.25: I heard a story about Prim and the Blackwater mountain settlement fighting against each other.
bwm_agent.30: I should follow the mountain path up the mountain to the Blackwater mountain settlement.
bwm_agent.40: I met the man again on my way up to Blackwater mountain. I should proceed further up the mountain.
bwm_agent.50: I have made it up to the snow-filled parts of the Blackwater mountain. The man told me to proceed further up the mountain. Apparently, the Blackwater mountain settlement is close by.
bwm_agent.60: I have reached the Blackwater mountain settlement. I should find and talk to their battle master, Harlenn.
bwm_agent.65: I have spoken to Harlenn in the Blackwater mountain settlement. Apparently, the settlement is under attack by a number of monsters, the aulaeth and white wyrms. On top of that, they are being attacked by the people of Prim.
bwm_agent.66: Harlenn thinks the people of Prim are behind the monster attacks somehow.
bwm_agent.70: Harlenn wants me to give a message to Guthbered of Prim. Either the people of Prim stop their attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement, or they will have to be dealt with themselves. I should go talk to Guthbered in Prim.
bwm_agent.80: Guthbered denies that the people of Prim have anything to do with the monster attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement. I should go talk to Harlenn.
bwm_agent.90: Harlenn is sure that the people of Prim are behind the attacks somehow.
bwm_agent.95: Harlenn wants me to go to Prim and look for signs that they are preparing for an attack on the settlement. I should go look for clues around where Guthbered stays.
bwm_agent.100: I have found some plans in Prim about recruiting mercenaries and attacking the Blackwater mountain settlement. I should go talk to Harlenn immediately.
bwm_agent.110: Harlenn thanked me for investigating the attack plans.
bwm_agent.120: To make the attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement stop, Harlenn wants me to assassinate Guthbered in Prim.
bwm_agent.130: I have started a fight with Guthbered.
bwm_agent.131: I told Guthbered that I was sent to kill him, but I let him live. He thanked me deeply, and left Prim.
bwm_agent.149: I have told Harlenn that Guthbered is gone.
bwm_agent.150: Harlenn thanked me for the help I have provided. Hopefully, the attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement should stop now.
bwm_agent.240: I am now trusted in the Blackwater mountain settlement, and all services should be available for me to use.
bwm_agent.250: I have decided to not help the people of the Blackwater mountain settlement.
bwm_agent.251: Since I am helping Prim, Harlenn no longer wants to talk to me.

andor.1: My father Mikhail says that Andor has not been home since yesterday. I should go look for him in the village.
andor.10: Leonid tells me that he saw Andor talking to Gruil. I should go ask Gruil if he knows more.
andor.20: Gruil wants me to bring him a poison gland. Then he might talk more. He tells me that some poisonous snakes have such a gland.
andor.30: Gruil tells me that Andor was looking for someone called Umar. I should go ask his friend Gaela in Fallhaven to the east.
andor.40: I talked to Gaela in Fallhaven. He tells me to go see Bucus and ask about the Thieves' Guild.
andor.50: Bucus has allowed me to enter the hatch in the derelict house in Fallhaven. I should go talk to Umar.
andor.51: Umar in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild recognized me, but must have me confused with Andor. Apparently, Andor has been to see him.
andor.55: Umar told me that Andor went to see a potion maker called Lodar. I should search for his hideaway.
andor.61: I heard a story in Loneford, where it seemed like Andor had been in Loneford, and that he might have had something to do with the illness that the people are suffering from there. I am not sure if it actually was Andor. If it was Andor, why would he have made the people of Loneford ill?
andor.62: Andor might have gone to do some business with a rich man in Brimhaven after he left Loneford.
andor.65: It looks like Andor was involved in the destruction of the Brimhaven dam.
andor.70: I have found the potion-maker Lodar, and heard his story about Andor. Andor went to visit Lodar in his hideaway to get a sample of something called Narwood extract. Lodar happened to notice that there was someone travelling together with Andor, that hid among the trees and did not seem to want Lodar to spot him.
andor.71: Shortly after Andor and the person he was travelling with had left, strange things started to happen in the woods around Lodar's hideaway, and Lodar himself seemed to be affected by it somehow. Lodar believes that something disturbed the tomb below his cabin, and awoke the Hira'zinn.
andor.72: Since I helped Lodar defeat the Hira'zinn, he promised to help me in return. He gave me a piece of paper that should allow me to enter the Valanyr temple of the Shadow in Nor City. He told me to seek out lady Lydalon in the temple for further assistance.
andor.80: All clues so far as to where Andor went point to Nor City. I should travel to Nor City by following the Duleian road to the southeast and look for more clues there.
andor.85: Andor may have been in Stoutford.
andor.86: Andor had something to do with the demon under the church in Stoutford.
andor.90: At Castle Guynmart I learned from Steward Unkorh that some time ago Andor was also there as a guest.
andor.92: Unkorh gave me the bonemeal potion box that Andor had given him for safekeeping.
andor.100: While exploring the town of Sullengard, I so happened to stumble upon my mother and my aunt to whom I have never met. Mother has insisted that I go home so we can talk.
andor.110: After talking with mother back at home, she and I tried to brainstorm about where Andor could be. She reminded me about Andor's friend Stanwick who lives in Brightport. We agreed that going to talk to him might be the next logical thing to do.
andor.120: In the dungeons of Laeroth manor, Kotheses, the torturer, mentioned that he had taught Andor the basics of torturing.
andor.125: Vaelric confirmed that Andor visited him recently. Andor sought to learn Vaelric's skills and left quickly, clutching what he came for. His actions raise more questions about his intentions.
andor.126: In Brightport, I was finally able to meet Stanwick, but due to his hazy memory, he was not able to help me learn anything about the whereabouts of Andor.
andor.127: Regaining his peace of mind after I helped him, Stanwick said he'll tell me more about Andor, once he gathers his thoughts.
andor.128: Stanwick gave me a signet ring that I should show to his father. Jorwick, in Nor City.
andor.130: Andor was trying to find out from Seraphina about terrible monsters in the hideout near the place with the larval burrowers.
andor.131: Elysa in the Brightport's thieves guild told me that Andor has bought a map to the sewers of Feygard.
andor.132: While investigating the Brightport theft I learned from Bryma that Andor was the one who stole the important document, and brought it to her in exchange for her alchemy knowledge.
andor.140: I saw Andor in the mountains of Galmore. We were able to exchange a few words before he disappeared again.
andor.145: I met Andor on the road to Feygard, where he was buying food from Rosmara. He disappeared again.
andor.147: I met Andor on the road to Nor City, where he was buying supplies from Alynndir. He disappeared again.
andor.910: I decided to settle down on the top of Mt. Galmore. For this I needed to find a rich and discreet man to rebuild the ruins according to my wishes. Andor will now have to go and find himself.
andor.912: The construction contract for my new home was completed. I was curious to see what it would look like.
andor.914: I visited my new residence on the top of Mt. Galmore. There I would help the people of Dhayavar as a hero and protect them from villains. Or would I become a villain myself? We'll see.
andor.999: [Quest is not completable at this time.]
